defs.def: all the people working on a ship, plane etc. except the officers who are in charge （轮船、飞机等上面不包括高级职员的）全体船员，全体乘务员

ex.s: Thousands of metres beneath the waves, its crew took incredible photos and videos and collected important samples from the ocean floor for research in oceanography.
ex.t: 在海浪下数千米处，其船员拍摄了令人难以置信的照片和视频，并为海洋学研究从海底收集了重要样本。

ex.s: No one who was present could hold back the tears – even the captain and crew, who were all men of iron.
ex.t: 在场的人无不热泪盈眶——连船长和船员这些铁打的汉子也是如此。

ex.s: The organisation believes that its project is giving people worldwide the chance to be part of the first human crew ever to live on Mars for good.
ex.t: 该组织相信，他们的项目正在让全世界的人有机会成为第一批永久生活在火星上的人类船员的一部分。

defs.def: a group of people with special skills working together 技术人员团队；专业团队

ex.s: That can be dangerous work that could be avoided with drones assisting the crews’ efforts.
ex.t: 通过使用最新技术，无人机还可以开始为铁路提供更高价值的服务，在铁轨或道岔造成安全问题之前检测故障。
